summary: Implemented every stub in tinydb/table.py: the name and storage properties, insert and insert_multiple (explicit and automatic IDs, duplicate checks), all, search with query cache, get, contains, update, update_multiple, upsert, remove, truncate, count, clear_cache, and the storage-backed _get_next_id, _read_table and _update_table helpers. The last full-suite run showed 199 passed and 2 failed; both failures are test_query_cache_with_mutable_callable, which depends on Query.map cacheability in queries.py owned by another builder.
